SEGMENT.TAILPOINTER.summary: Returns the tail pointer of a segment in a volume.
SEGMENT.TAILPOINTER.complexity: O(S + K) where S is the number of segments in the volume and K is the number of changelog entries at the tail position.

reply_schema.description: The tail pointer of the segment.

items.description: Byte offset of the next write in the segment. 0 if no entry was written to the segment.
Changelog sequence number of the last write. -1 if the segment is not the active segment, no entry was written to it, or its changelog entry was pruned.
